Commentary.Commentary: So that is from this game! We have our firsts Semi Finalists this year's World Cup, Australia. England on the other hand, have a tough road ahead. They probably need to win both their games against New Zealand and India to qualify. On the 26th though, it is one side which has a chance to seal its place in the Semis, New Zealand and the other who needs to win all their games starting from Wednesday to have a chance to make it to the semi finals, Pakistan. They both lock horns in Edgbaston and the game begins at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Till then take care and goodbye!

Australia skipper, Aaron Finch says they are pleased and reckons they have played good cricket and are looking to build on it. Tells England are a stand out side and can take the game away. Says it was important to chip in with wickets as Stokes and Buttler can take the game away. On the inspired team changes, he says Behrendorff was bought as he can swing the ball both ways and says it is fantastic the way he bowled. On Warner's new approach, Finch tells that he is respecting the bowlers more and is looking to build a base rather than going after it. Tells they are confident and it gives them a good chance to play their best cricket.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says they were outplayed and they did not bowl well upfront. Reckons they played well in the top and capitalized on it. Says though it got easier to bat later on they did not apply themselves in. Says the wicket was soft, he laughs and says wish they would have batted. Credits Finch for the innings they played and Reckons it is not too disappointing as they still have their faith in their own hands. Admits they need to turnaround everything and he is not looking to point out just one error.

MAN OF THE MATCH, Aaron Finch, says anytime you contribute when your team wins, is special. Says it was good to see through the initial tough period and get to a century. Tells us building that opening stand with Warner was crucial. On this being his 7th ODI ton against England, he says it gives him confidence and it is good to score against a tough opposition. Says it was seaming and zipping initially in the day and they were just looking to cash in on the lose deliveries.

Earlier in the day, Australia were inserted and their openers got them off to a brilliant start. Their skipper, scored his second ton of the World Cup. They could not finish strongly but the runs they had on the board proved to be enough in the end.

Their bowling was probably about the two left-arm seamers! One who is making a name for himself in ICC Tournaments and the other who has put in a performance he would never forget in only his second game in World Cups. Jason Behrendorff and Mitchell Starc. The two were given the new balls and they ran through the English top order. They were excellent at the death as well. The duo had 9 wickets amongst them with Jason Behrendorff taking 5 and Starc finishing with 4. A word of praise to the others as well as they hardly gave anything away and never let the pressure ease off. Stoinis had one wicket to his name and it was the big one of Buttler.

The much talked English batting line-up failed to chase 232 in their last game and now have failed to overhaul 286 in this one. They have lost this match quite convincingly and there is pin-drop silence in the stadium. They actually can't believe what has happened. Once again their openers failed to get them off to a good start as they lost Vince for a duck. The ever reliable Root did not make an impact and Morgan too was bounced out. Stokes and Bairstow did look to steady the ship but Jonny threw it away. Then Stokes and Buttler revived English hopes but Khawaja's catch put an end to that stand too. All the hopes were then pinned on Stokes but the task was too much. An outstanding delivery saw him being dismissed 11 short of a ton. The game was more-or-less in Australia's bag when they got rid of the all-rounder and they pressed home the advantage and won the game easily in the end.

AUSTRALIA ARE INTO THE SEMIS! They are the first team to book their place in the knockouts after beating tournament favorites, England. However, I am not sure who will be more happier at the moment? Australia, Pakistan or Bangladesh because this loss has completely opened the table.

OUT! Straight to covers! Starc gets the last man! His 4th wicket today. He goes full and around off, Rashid looks to hit it over covers but ends up hitting it flat to Stoinis over there. He makes no mistake. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 64 RUNS!
Cramps the batter for room by bowling it into the body. Rashid looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is right off the middle. Fuller and on off, this is hit over covers. Past the diving fielder in the deep and a boundary results.
FOUR! Top edge and a boundary! Short and on middle, Rashid looks to pull but gets a top edge over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Good length and on middle, this is guided to point. End of Jason Behrendorff's spell. Outstanding stuff from him. He has taken 5 and give away 44 in his 10.
Slower one on the pads, Rashid looks to flick but gets it off his pads  It rolls on the leg side a leg bye taken.
A slower yorker outside off, this is jammed out to point for one.
Mark Wood walks out at number 11.

OUT! Fifer for Jason Behrendorff! What a performance by him. He was picked in the side for this game after being dropped for the last and bowls a match winning spell. He goes fuller and on off, JA looks to go over long off. Does not get under the delivery and hits it flat to long off where Warner makes no mistake. He has three more balls to take a 6-fer.
Swing and a miss! Full and outside off, Archer shuffles across and looks to heave it on the leg side but misses.
On the shorter side, Rashid pulls it, not off the middle, towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Another full toss, all Rashid can do is hit it through covers for one.
A full toss outside off, Rashid looks to carve it but misses.
A yorker on off, Archer pushes it through covers for one.
A single! Rashid clears his front leg and hits it through covers for one.
Another swing and miss! Length and outside off, Rashid looks to go over covers but misses.
A yorker outside off, Rashid fails to jam it out.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack.
A dot to end another successful over for Jason! On a length and around off, this pitches and moves away. Archer looks to defend but gets beaten.
Good length and on off, this is guided through point for one.
FOUR! Just over! Rashid is continuing to fight. This is on the pads, Rashid flicks it over the short fine leg fielder and bags a boundary.
Jofra Archer walks out to bat next.

OUT! Another excellent catch! Excellent team work I should say between Maxwell and Finch! Jason Behrendorff gets his fourth. The slower one on middle, Woakes shuffles across and looks to clear the mid-wicket fence. It is the longer part of the ground. Maxwell in the deep runs to his right, keeps one eye on the ropes and takes it. He then realizes that the momentum is taking him over the ropes so he lobs it to Finch who runs to his right from long on. Woakes, England's last hope is dismissed.
The umpires have a few words and are happy with the catch.
Clever batting! This is what Rashid needs to do. He drops it towards point for one.
Slower one and very full and on off, Woakes hits it down to long off for one.
A dot to end! But 9 from it. Almost what they need per over. Full and outside off, Rashid looks to jam it out but misses. 86 needed in the last 9 overs.
Woakes now takes one by pushing it down to long on. 200 up for England.
This is on off, it turns back in. Rashid works it towards mid-wicket for one. Sensible batting.

SIX! Rashid says the game is not over yet! What a shot! Uses his feet and gets to the pitch of it, lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie. For a second Starc must have felt he had a chance but it clears him.
Floats it up on off, Rashid hits it to covers.
On the shorter side and around off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Nathan Lyon is back into the attack.
Powerplay 3 is signaled. Maximum of 5 fielders can be outside the circle till the end of this innings.
Good length around off, this is guided to point. So a wicket and just the 7 runs from the over. 95 needed in 60 balls for England. They only have 3 wickets in hand.
Another single as Woakes guides this through covers for one.
Rashid is off the mark! He works this through square leg for one.
Adil Rashid is the next batsman in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Moeen Ali is out of here! Jason Behrendorff has the last laugh! Excellent delivery this. It is on a length and around off, holds its line after pitching. Moeen looks to put bat on ball but ends up playing inside the line. The ball kisses the outside edge and goes to the keeper. Into the bowling all-rounders now are Australia. Seems an impossible task for England now. 97 needed in 63.

FOUR! First boundary for Moeen Ali and England will hope it is just the start! Length and outside off, Moeen just lofts it over covers, shorter side that and it is a boundary. Runs needed below 100 now.
Fuller and on off, this is hit through extra cover for one.
Jason Behrendorff is back into the attack. 7-0-28-2 so far.
Good change up! He bangs it short after a few full ones. Moeen ducks under it. Just the single from the over.
A full toss and on off, Moeen mistimes it to mid off.
Another one right up there, Moeen looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller and tailing back in, Moeen strokes it to mid on.
Fuller and outside off, this is carved away through point for one.
Fuller and on off, Woakes pushes it to covers.
On the pads again, the batter looks to flick but misses. It brushes his pads and rolls to the left of the keeper who gets there and stops it with a dive. Leg bye signaled!
Shorter in length and on the body, this is worked towards backward square leg for one.
A little too straight, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Almost plays it on! This is on a length and around off, Moeen looks to push at it but it goes off the inside edge towards the leg side for one.
On the fuller side, this is creamed to the man at mid off.
Back of a length on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Short and down the leg side, Woakes looks to work it on the leg side but misses.
Moeen Ali is the next batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Starc does what Starc does best! Knocks the stumps over. Sends Stokes back to the pavilion 11 short of a ton. Stokes may have also taken back the hopes of this England side of chasing this down. Something special was needed to get rid of Stokes and Starc bowls a corker of a yorker. It tails back in from outside off. It is at 145 KPH. Stokes fails to get his bat down in time and the off pole is hit. Starc is pumped up. A brilliant innings by Stokes comes to an end but England wanted him to last longer. 109 needed from 78.
Just a single! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through point for one.
On the stumps, this is kept out.

Just short! A good stop in the end! Starc goes full and just outside off, Woakes plays it late, it goes uppishly but lands just short of point where Maxwell dives and makes a half-stop. Can't stop two though.
Full and tailing back in! Stokes works it towards wide mid on for one.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Mitchell Starc is back on! Finch senses he needs to break this stand and gets Starc on.

FOUR! Woakes gets into the act now! Third boundary in the over and a huge one. 13 from it. Does this over change the momentum? Short and around off, Woakes drags it through mid-wicket and it races away. 113 needed in 84 balls now.
End of that pattern as this short one is pulls through square leg for one.
Good length and on off, this is guided to point. So a boundary followed by a dot is the pattern in this over till now.

FOUR! To the left of extra cover! Three balls and two boundaries in the over! Stokes once again uses his feet and makes room again. Cummins bowls this slightly fuller and this is powered past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
That never took off! Unplayable! Good length and outside off, Stokes looks to defend but the ball stays low and sneaks under the bat.

FOUR! Hit hard, short square boundaries and a boundary! Stokes dances down the track and also makes room. Cummins bangs it short. Stokes slaps it through cover-point and it races away. The over starts with a boundary. Ideal start.
Gives it a lot of air and lands it on off, this is defended. Just the four from this one. 126 needed in the last 15 overs.
Floats it up on off, Woakes pushes it to covers.
Shortish and on off, Stokes hits it to the cover fielder at the edge of the ring for one.
Flatter and on middle, Woakes works it towards backward square leg for one.
Another single as Stokes works it wide of mid on.
This is on middle, it is worked down to deep backward square leg for one.

FOUR! Second boundary in the over! Gets it past the diving mid on fielder! Short and on middle, Stokes pulls it, it is not off the middle but beats Warner at mid off and it races away to the fence. 9 runs from the over. A good one for England. They would like a few more like these.
Mistimed! This is slightly fuller and on middle, Stokes looks to go big but the bat turns in his hands and it goes to mid on.
Back of a length on middle, Stokes defends it onto the ground.
This is around off, Woakes guides it down to third man for one.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for England! England would hope this gets Woakes going. Fuller and on the pads, Woakes works it through wide long on for a boundary. 150 up for England.
On the stumps, Woakes keeps it out.
Pat Cummins is back on! his figures so far 5-1-14-0.

Well fielded again! Stokes brings out the reverse sweep, hits it well towards short third man. The fielder there dives to his right and stops it. Just the two from the over. 139 more needed in 17 overs.
Misfield and a run! Shorter and around, Woakes hits it to covers where the fielder lets it through and a single is taken.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid on for one.
Well fielded! Shorter and outside off, Stokes slaps it to the right of covers but Smith there dives and stops it with one hand.
Flatter outside off, Stokes looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Flatter and around off, Stokes pushes it to covers.
Nathan Lyon is back into the attack. 6-0-28-0 so far.
Good length and on off, Woakes hits it towards mid off. Just the 4 from the over, Stoinis is bowling some good overs here.
Uses his feet and hits it down to long on for another run.
Full and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on the body, this is pulled to fine leg for one.

Another risky run! An off cutter outside off, this pitches and comes back in. Woakes looks to guide it down to third man but it goes off the inner half onto the body and then rolls behind the wicket. The batter go for a run, Carey does have a shy but misses. Stokes was in though had he hit.
This is on the pads, Woakes works it towards mid-wicket.
DRINKS!
Another dot to end but a lovely over for England. 12 from it. This is on off, Stokes guides it to point.
On the stumps again and this is blocked out.
On the stumps, this is kept out.
SIX! Another one! This time it is flat! This is angled into the batter. Stokes goes down on one knee and sweeps it powerfully and over the mid-wicket fence.
Flatter and on off, this is guided to point.
SIX! Releases a little pressure! A hit-me ball! Short and on the body, Stokes has enough time to go back and pull it hard over the square leg fence for a huge one.
Full on middle, Woakes drives it to mid on.
On a length on off, Woakes keeps it out.

RUN OUT CHANCE! MISSED! A run out is the last thing England want at this stage. Good length ball on middle, Stokes tucks it towards mid-wicket and calls for a quick single. Woakes responds to it. Smith at short mid-wicket gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the keeper's end. He misses the stumps by just a few inches. Direct Hit and Woakes was out for all money. Lucky escape this for England.
Slower short ball on off, Stokes looks to guide but gets deceived by the pace. It goes towards short third man.
Full on middle, Stokes defends it back towards the bowler.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Stokes comes down the track and plays it to covers.
Another single as Stokes works it through square leg.
Shorter and outside off, Woakes slaps it through covers and takes one.
This lands outside off and turns back in. Woakes looks to defend but gets hit high on the pads.
Floats it up outside off, Woakes looks to drive but misses.
Outside off and this turns back in. Woakes works it to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on middle, this is pushed towards mid on for a quick run.
Glenn Maxwell is into the attack.
On a good length and around off, this is kept out.
This one is shorter in length, Stokes pulls it through square leg for one.
Slower one on middle, this is kept out.
Very full on the stumps, this is jammed out.
Chris Woakes walks out to bat next.

OUT! What a catch that is! Stoinis gets the big fish! The England fans have their heads down. They can't believe what just happened! The stand which probably was getting Australia a little worried has been cut short. This is on the pads, Buttler whips it hard but flat towards deep square leg. Khawaja there runs to his right and hangs onto it. It was traveling, it could have easily bursts through his hands. The Australians are elated. England need another 162.
Dances down the track but the length is short, Stokes guides it through point and takes one.
Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Good running! The arm ball on middle, Stokes goes back and pushes it towards cover. The batters take one. 5 from the over.
Shorter and on middle, this is whipped towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Looks to play the paddle sweep but it goes off the inner half onto the pads and on the leg side.
Good fielding by Cummins! Short and outside off, Buttler hits it through point. Cummins in the deep runs to his left, dives and pushes it back in. Saves two for his side.
Buttler dances down the track but Lyon shortens the length. Buttler looks to defend but it goes off the pads towards cover.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

FOUR! Bludgeoned! That is some hit! Buttler takes a few steps down the track and converts it into a full ball. He hammers it past long on and bags a boundary. The last ball spoils the over. Not for the first time today. 8 from it. 169 needed in 144.
Slightly shorter and around middle, Stokes pulls it through square leg for one.
On the pads, Stokes looks to work but misses, he gets hit on the pads.
Length and around off, Buttler strokes it through covers for one.

Fifty for Stokes! He has played a few important knocks in this World Cup but none more than this. However, his job is only half done. This is his 18th ODI fifty. He gets there by flicking the full toss through square leg for one.
Length delivery on middle, Buttler flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Stokes misreads the line there. He needs to be careful! This is shorter and just outside off, Stokes goes back and looks to cut but it is too close. It beats the outside edge.
Floats it up on off, this is defended.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
Shorter on off, Stokes hits it to covers.

LEADING EDGE BUT FOUR! This is tossed up on middle, it holds onto the wicket. Stokes closes the face of the bat early, it goes off the leading edge above the bowler's hand and through mid on for a boundary. A fortunate boundary but England won't care how they come as long as they come.
A low full toss, Buttler looks to drive it down the ground but it goes off the bottom to the keeper.
On the shorter side and on the body, Stokes pulls it through square leg for one.
Shorter and on the body, Buttler looks to pull but it hits the body and rolls towards fine leg for one. Leg bye signaled!
Full and on the pads, Stokes works it through square leg for a run. The fifty-run stand is up between the two. A vital one but the job is not even half done.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Good fielding! Stokes charges and Stoinis bowls it short. Stokes guides it towards backward point. The fielder there dives to his right and stops it.
Flighted delivery outside off, Jos looks to play the sweep but misses it and gets hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal but it is turned down.
Full on off, Stokes drives it towards covers for a run.
Short on off, Stokes makes room and cuts it to point.
Floated delivery on off, Stokes keeps it out.
FOUR! Nice shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Stokes sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 100 up for England.
Tossed up on off, Stokes pushes it back towards the bowler.
Nathan Lyon is back into the attack. 3-0-14-0, his figures so far.
Another single as this is hit down to long on.
A very full ball on middle, Stokes jams it out.
Fuller again and on middle, Buttler works it through mid-wicket for one.

A direct hit and Buttler was a goner! This is on a length and around off, Stokes looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket. The batters go for one. Smith picks the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but luckily for Buttler, he misses. England can't afford a run out at the moment. That was a risky run.

NOT OUT! Impact is outside off! Australia lose their only review. A poor one to be honest. That was more in hope, desperation. Buttler walks down the track and is also standing outside the off stump. Buttler looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Stoinis is appealing as the batters run a leg bye as the ball rolls towards mid on. Stoinis likes it and wants it to be reviewed. Carey does not feel it is worth a review. Finch takes it though. Replays roll in and show the on-field call is the right one.
A review right at the end by Australia! An appeal for an LBW has been turned down. Buttler is the man in question. He was too ahead there. Also, the impact is an issue.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On the shorter side, Buttler gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards fine leg for one.
Slower one on off, Stokes pushes it towards cover for an easy run.
Another one on the body of the batter, Stokes works it towards mid-wicket. The batters think of a run but then bail out.
On the stumps again, this is blocked.
Back of a length on off, Stokes pushes it to covers.
A couple now! Too straight again, Buttler works it through square leg for two. Expensive start from Stoinis.
Buttler takes a few steps down the track but Stoinis bowls a yorker. It is jammed out.
This is on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

FOUR! Stokes is on the charge here! He comes down the track and makes into a full ball. He lofts it over mid on for a boundary. England may just decide to take on Stoinis as he is the weak link in this Australian bowling line-up. Runs needed below 200.
A muted appeal but nothing from the umpire! Shorter and outside off, this one takes off after pitching. Stokes looks to guide it down to third man but gets beaten.
This is on the pads, Buttler works it through mid-wicket for one.
Marcus Stoinis is into the attack.
On the fuller side and on middle, Stokes works it to mid on. So just the boundary from the over
Good stop! This is on a length and around off, Stokes looks to defend but it goes off the outer half towards point where Maxwell dives to his right and stops it.
FOUR! That has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Stokes dances down the track and Cummins bangs it short. Stokes powers it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
This is angled into the batter, Stokes works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on off, Stokes keeps it out.
Comes down the track but the length is short. Stokes hits it to mid off.
Pat Cummins is back into the attack.
Well fielded! Shorter and on the body, Stokes pulls it firmly, it goes quicky towards fine leg who runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to one.
Goes full now and this one tails back in. Stokes hits it to mid on.
A little too straight again, this is worked behind square for two.
Another short one, this hurries onto the batsman, Buttler is late into the pull. It hits the glove and rolls towards square leg for one.
This is on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! Short of a length delivery on leg, Stokes pulls it towards fine leg. It goes to the fielder in one bounce. The batsmen get two runs.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On the stumps again, this is kept out.
Shorter and outside off, Stokes goes back and pushes it wide of cover for a couple.
Close again! This is flatter and on middle, it skids through. Stokes just about jams it out.
Beauty! That turned and bounced! This is flatter just outside off, it pitches and turns in sharply. Cuts Buttler into half, the keeper fails to collect it and it goes down to fine leg for a bye.
Flighted delivery on middle, Stokes flicks it towards fine leg. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it. The batsmen get three runs.

FOUR! He has done well! A low full toss outside off, Buttler looks to drive but it goes off the bottom edge down towards third man. Jason runs across, dives and pushes it back in. The umpires goes upstairs to check. Replays roll in and they show that Jason Behrendorff did touch the ropes but he had pushed the ball away. Two to end the over. Expensive return for Starc.

Has that been stopped cleanly? Jason Behrendorff runs to his left from third man and stops the ball from going to the fence with a dive. His feet touch the rope but it looks to be clean. Let's say what the replays have to say.
Goes short and on the body, Stokes pulls it down to fine leg for one.
On the fuller side once again, Stokes pushes it back to Starc.
This is angled into the batter, Stokes pushes it to mid on.
In the air... but just wide! Fuller and outside off, Buttler looks to drive it once again but it flies off the outer half past point and down to third man for one.
FOUR! Exquisite! Lovely timing on this one! Fuller and on off, no swing at all. Buttler leans forward and strokes it through covers for a boundary. First boundary for Buttler.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack. Finch has turned out to his gun bowler.
Shorter and outside off, the batter goes back and pushes it through covers for one.
Fires it into the pads, Stokes works it through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, Stokes goes back and defends it out.
On the stumps, this is kept out.
Floats it up outside off, Buttler looks to drive it against the turn through the off side but it goes off the inner half down to long on for one.
Floats it up on off, Buttler keeps it out.
Buttler is off the mark straightaway! This is a back of a length ball around off, Buttler guides it down to third man for one.
Jos Buttler walks out to bat next. We know what Buttler is capable of and he needs to deliver here for England.

OUT! In the air... taken! Jonny Bairstow has thrown it away! The change of ends works wonders for Jason Behrendorff! It is short and outside off, Jonny looks to drag his pull but his one hand comes off the handle. It takes the top edge and goes high up in the air towards the fielder in the deep at mid-wicket. Cummins once again makes no mistake. England slip further. Another 233 runs needed in 217 balls.
Good length and outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Good length and around off, it is kept out.
This time he does work it around the corner and takes one.

Just short! The change of ends almost does the trick. This is angled into the batter, Stokes looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge but falls just short of Warner at covers.
Jason Behrendorff is back into the attack.
This is on the pads, JB works it to square leg. A tidy start by Lyon.
Another single as Stokes pushes it through covers.
Well played but well fielded! Stokes brings the reverse sweep out but hits it too fine. Smith seeing Stokes change the grip moves to his left and also a little behind. He stops it.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.

In the air... but safe! Almost an action reply of how Warner got out. This is shorter and around off, it takes off after pitching. Stokes looks to cut but then seeing the extra bounce looks to bail out. It hits the higher portion of the bat and lobs through cover-point for one. Fifty up for England.
Shorter and around off, Stokes goes back and slaps it through extra cover. Takes two.
For the first time in this World Cup Nathan Lyon is into the attack. He would want to make an impact straightaway.
A nicely controlled pull shot! On the shorter side, Stokes goes back and pulls it towards fine leg just for a single.
Goes back to bowling it just outside off, Stokes shoulders arms to it.
Good running! This time there is more width on offer, Stokes guides it past point and for a couple.
Loose shot! Shortish and just outside off, Stokes looks to go after it but the ball beats the bat. That was loose from Stokes. Too close to play that shot.
Good length and on off, Stokes lunges and defends it out.
On the pads, Bairstow flicks it down to fine leg and takes an easy run.
Full on middle, Stokes defends it off the back foot. Just 4 runs from the over.
On a good length and outside off, Stokes comes down the track and plays it to point.
On a good length on off, Stokes keeps it out.
FOUR! Stokes is off the mark after 11 dots. Jeez but that is some way to get off the mark. Length ball outside off, Stokes comes down the track and smashes is through covers for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Stokes blocks it off his back foot.
On a good length and outside off, Stokes defends it out.
Powerplay 2 is signaled. Maximum of 4 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
A good looking drive to end Powerplay 1! Good length and on middle, this is pushed to mid on. Australia easily on top after the first 10. England are 39 for 3. Another 247 needed in 240 balls.
A little too straight again and Jonny works it to square leg.
FOUR! Too straight and Bairstow puts it away! This is also fuller and on the pads, Jonny clips it through mid-wicket and bags a boundary. First runs of Cummins' bowling.
Continues bowling it on a length and on off, JB goes back and keeps it out again.
This is angled into the batter, Bairstow works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, JB stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Extra bounce there! Good length and around off, shoots after pitching. Stokes defends it by taking one hand off the handle.
Back of a length on off, Stokes stands tall and keeps it out. Still hasn't got off the mark.
Slightly shorter in length and around off, Bairstow pulls it through mid-wicket and takes one.
FOUR! Punched away! Slightly shorter and outside off, Bairstow pushes it in the gap in the cover region and the ball races away to the fence.
Flashes and misses! Outside off, JB looks to hit it through the off side but misses it.
Back of a length and on off, Bairstow hits it to mid on.
On the shorter side and outside off, Stokes looks to pull but misses. A maiden to begin with by Cummins.
BEATEN! Stokes takes a few steps down the track but Cummins lands it behind a length. Gets it to angle away. Stokes looks to defend but gets beaten.
Outside off, left alone.
Back of a length again and on off, Stokes stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
On the stumps, this is pushed back to mid on.
Good length and outside off, Stokes lets it be.
Pat Cummins is into the attack.
Goes back to bowling length and on middle, this is defended.

FOUR! Just over mid off! Bairstow would have surely had his heart in his mouth! This is on a length and around off, Bairstow looks to hit it on the up. It goes off the higher portion of the bat and over mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length on middle, Bairstow stands tall and defends it out.
Well bowled again! This lands on middle and straightens. Bairstow looks to play it with a straight bat but it goes off the outer half to point.
On the fuller side again on middle, Bairstow hits it back to the bowler.
Around off, Bairstow looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to mid on.
On the fuller side and around off, Stokes pushes it to covers. Another successful over for Australia.
Ben Stokes walks out to bat next.

OUT! Number 3 is down! Australia are all over England at the moment. The full ball gets Root and the short one gets the England skipper. It is on the body. Morgan looks to pull but the ball goes off the top edge towards fine leg where Cummins takes one running to his left and then falls over. That got big onto Morgan. Pin-drop silence in the stadium here.
On the fuller side and this one comes back in. Bairstow waits for it and then works it on the leg side for one.
Back of a length now and outside off, JB lets it go.
FOUR! Need not run for those! Very delightful shot. Full and outside off, Bairstow extends his arms and creams it through cover for a boundary.
On middle, Jonny works it to square leg.
Good length and outside off, Morgan lets it go. Good batting, having got a boundary in the over, another risk is not needed.

FOUR! What a shot! This is the new England! They are two down but are still looking to attack. Morgan dances down the track and makes it into a half-volley. He smashes it through mid off and the ball races away to the fence.
Way too wide outside off, Morgan reaches out for it but chops it to the off side.
Sprays this one down the leg side, it has been wided.
On the pads, JB looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Inside edge! On a length and around off, Bairstow plays outside the line, the ball hits the inside edge and hits the pads.
Good length and outside off, Bairstow leaves it alone.
This is on the pads again, Morgan tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A wicket maiden by Starc.
BEATEN! On the fuller side and outside off, Morgan looks to drive it through the off side but misses.
Shorter and on the body, Morgan works it to mid-wicket.
Eoin Morgan walks out to bat next.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb in front! Australia have another one here! England in big, big trouble! Both the opening bowlers have one each. Starc steams in and bowls this fuller and outside off, this one comes back in late. Root plants his front foot across and then tries to flick but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. An appeal and Root walks off. He does not even think of a review as he knew he is a goner. 271 more needed. Body blow this for England as Root has been in excellent form in this World Cup and the glue around which this destructive English batting works around.
On the fuller side and outside off, Root looks to drive it through the off side again, this one takes the inside edge and hits the pad.
BEATEN! This is slightly fuller and outside off, Root looks to drive it through the off side but it comes in and goes past the inside edge.
Another one on the pads, JB looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Just the boundary from the over.
Another good length and on off, this is kept out.
FOUR! Lovely clip! This is a little too straight by Jason Behrendorff. Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away. The outfield is pretty fast here.
Shorter in length and on the body, Bairstow looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
On the off pole, JB goes back and defends it onto the ground.
Good delivery! This lands around off, angles away and also zips through. Bairstow first looks to cut but then bails out.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Root shoulders arms to it. A dot to end but a good over for England.
FOUR! Two boundaries in two balls for Root! Too easy this, on the pads, Root works it fine on the leg side and bags a boundary. This is not a good follow-up over by Starc till now.
Edgy run! This is full and wide outside off, Bairstow throws his bat at it, the ball goes off the outside edge to third man for one.

Good shot! Not a boundary but two! Slightly fuller and outside off, Jonny strokes it through cover-point. The fielder from cover and point give it a chase and some teamwork from the two ensures it is just the two.
This one is angled across the batter, Bairstow makes another leave.
Well bowled! Just outside off and this comes back in. Not enough though to make the batter play.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.

FOUR! Off the mark in style are England and Root. This is once again outside off but the length is shorter. Root goes back and cuts it past the diving point fielder and bags a boundary. A four to end but a top class first over by Jason.
Another length ball outside off, Root lets it be.
Excellent stop! Australia need to be brilliant in the field! This is shorter and around off, Root stands tall and guides it towards point where Maxwell dives to his right and stops it.
Angles this one away from around off, Root shoulders arms to this one.
Joe Root is the new batsman in.

OUT! BOOM! Behrendorff knocks Vince over! What a start for Australia and what a delivery by Jason. Another failure for Vince and once again the opening stand for England fails to contribute anything significant. JB runs in and bowls this right up there. It starts from off and swings back in late. Vince fails to adjust to the movement. The ball hits the pads and then deflects onto the stumps. A duck for Vince. Dream start on his comeback game for Behrendorff.
Goes fuller and gets the ball to come back in. Vince plays it with the movement to mid on.

We are back for the chase. The Australian players are out in the middle. Jonny Bairstow and James Vince will open the batting for England. Jason Behrendorff will open the bowling for Australia. He has the first new ball in hand. We saw the English bowlers get some swing, can he get the ball to move too? He can be deadly if he does so. Here we go...
